package_type: public-safe skill recommendations (research only; no live installs, no vendored third-party bodies)
non_goals: Do not auto-install or write into the live skill library
Do not create monitors or routines as part of accepting these recommendations
Do not copy licensed third-party skill or checklist bodies
Do not claim a skill can enforce app-level approval gates
Do not choose a blanket copyright licence for third-party material

recommendations.title: Outbound approval review and regression checks
recommendations.gap: Existing send-time skills (send-on-behalf, agent-email, purchases, in-chat-forms) do not provide post-event review or regression checks. A skill cannot enforce app-level approval gates.

recommendations.title: Agent department mapping and overlap review
recommendations.gap: No catalogue skill maps agents into departments or flags overlapping jobs. usage-review, team-bot-links, and export-bot-template do not do this.

recommendations.title: Safe agent retirement and handover
recommendations.gap: export-bot-template shares a bot; routines change jobs. Neither is a decommissioning and handover runbook with an explicit-yes gate.

recommendations.title: External skill provenance and security review
recommendations.gap: skill-authoring manages user-created skills; it is not a pre-install provenance, licence, and instruction review of third-party skills.

recommendations.title: Fleet privacy and permission review
recommendations.gap: Sign-in and send-time skills are not a periodic least-privilege review of fleet connectors. This is not legal advice.

recommendations.title: Work evidence pack for evaluation
recommendations.gap: pstack show-me-your-work is a coding decision trail, not a redacted shareable evidence pack for evaluation.
